script_text: Get ready to ignite your fire like never before this week! Early week opens with Mars, ruler Aries, sextiling Neptune Monday for creative bursts in your 5th House; Venus trines Jupiter in Taurus Tuesday, sparking love; Mercury opposite Pluto Wednesday creates storms, making Wednesday the worst day. The Sun enters your 7th House Thursday, shifting focus to partnerships and the Mars retrograde ends. Mid‑week turning point: Sun conjuncts your 10th House Thursday, launching career recognition. Late week: Moon squares Saturn Friday urging work; the weekend holds a Jupiter sextile to your 2nd House, boosting financial luck and confidence. Thursday is your power day as the Sun conjoins your 1st House, sparking confidence; Monday is your worst day with the Moon squaring Mars, sparking conflicts. Channel your Fire energy by drafting a bold project proposal before the weekend with confidence and focus. Follow for daily updates.
